title: Shared Capacity Slots
user: A two-to-five-person service business with different services, staff, rooms, or equipment who needs to expose real capacity without one person’s calendar falsely blocking another service.
smallest_useful_product: Offline capacity simulator: define people/resources/service requirements, import busy ICS blocks, calculate offerable slots, and export an availability table/ICS feed. Non-goals: public booking UI, payments, staff surveillance, or enterprise resource planning.
success_measure: For a representative four-week schedule, its proposed slots produce zero resource conflicts and recover at least 10% more valid slots than a single shared calendar.
constraints: ICS import must stay local by default; timezone/DST behavior needs exhaustive tests; output is advisory and must not silently create bookings.
